displayName: Onions and Alfalfa or Wheat (keep apart: onion thrips)

keepApart.reason: Onion thrips build up in alfalfa and wheat and move to onions when those crops are cut or harvested
keepApart.source: UMass Extension Vegetable Program, "Onion Thrips" fact sheet, https://www.umass.edu/agriculture-food-environment/vegetable/fact-sheets/onion-thrips
